newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, but NYMEX heat extends slide.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, but NYMEX heat extends slide.

text.p: Brent crude futures were quoted steady on Tuesday compared with London, but weak NYMEX products indicated further weakness to come.
February Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $23.10/$23.30 per barrel, around the London settlement price of $23.19. There were no trades recorded by midday.
NYMEX February crude, trading on the after-hours ACCESS system, was also steady. The last trade at $24.76 was down just three cents from the New York close.
But heating oil, which has led the futures complex this week, extended its slide on ACCESS, unsettled by above average temperatures in the key demand area of the U.S. northeast.
However, brokers said some support was emerging because the weather forecast for Wednesday to Friday was for lower than average temperatures.
Smith Barney meteorologist Jon Davis said Monday temperatures would average eight to 10 degrees above normal on Monday and Tuesday but then seven to 12 below normal Wednesday to Friday.
